note: closed_loop grading over hidden per-run seeds; a fresh oracle run varies slightly by seed, so ratios land near 1.0 (cap 1.5). full_at 0.825 is where the reward saturates to 1.0; it encodes the same seed-to-seed tolerance the task has always used and stays until a multi-run spread measurement justifies tightening it.
